company.shortDescription: Farid is an edtech firm that offers individual training for building the character of children between the ages of 3 and 18.
company.description: Farid edtech platform offers one-on-one character development and mental health treatment directly to Middle East and North Africa students. In addition to character education and mental health support, the platform will enable graduates and children to become certified trainers by providing mental health support and character education for children and youth from 3 to 18 years.
